referenceSources.title: opel corsa a GSI
referenceSources.description:
A fully restored white 1989 Opel Corsa A GSI hatchback is parked on grass next to a metal fence, displaying the racing number 38 on its side and a Spanish license plate M 5926 KB. The front grille features the GSI badge, and a yellow “ATENCION 50” sign is visible in the background. The car’s lowered stance and gold Braid alloy wheels hint at its performance upgrades.

The seller’s ad details a complete engine rebuild with new pistons, bearings, seals, crankshaft, camshaft, valves, belts, water pump, thermostat, and heater radiator. Performance enhancements include a Spesso Racing head gasket, lightweight balanced flywheel, polished intake ports, and a planed block from a Corsa B 1.6 16V. Extras such as Bilstein suspension, front strut brace, IRESA exhaust manifolds, OMP steering wheel and pedals, and a VDO oil temperature gauge round out the modifications. The car has passed its ITV inspection with no faults and comes with all original parts and spares for €2,400.
